rationale: The long thesis remains intact: SPEM is holding above session VWAP ($51.89) near the day's high on 4.8x relative volume, consistent with a gap-down recovery that is bucking a soft SPY tape. The recent one-minute drift from $52.15 to $52.12 is low-volume consolidation, not distribution, and price has never approached the $51.84 invalidation (MAE only -0.15%). Flipping to short into above-VWAP strength lacks sufficient evidence to justify the added costs, so holding is the best use of the current structure.
